title: Birth! A Magical Girl!
overview: Illya has been chosen by the Kaleidostick Ruby to become the new magical girl.

title: Who?
overview: A challenger appears, just when Illya is having trouble collecting the Rider card under Rin's instructions.

title: Girl Meets Girl
overview: A mysterious transfer student, Miyu Edelfelt, has joined Illya's class. Is she friend or rival?

title: We Lost
overview: Illya and her friends have been defeated by Caster. They must figure out how to improve their teamwork in order to win the rematch.

title: There are two options?
overview: There is no time to celebrate their hard-won victory, as Saber card suddenly appears to strike down Rin and Luvia. Faced with their strongest opponent yet, which option will Illya and Miyu choose?

title: A Blank, and the End of Night…
overview: Illya calls upon the power of the Archer card to defeat Saber.

title: Triumph and Escape
overview: Illya stays home to recover from a fever, but gets into some hijinks with Miyu. That night they attempt to capture the Assassin card.

title: The Normal Girl has Returned
overview: Suffering from shell shock, Illya tells Rin she wants to resign from being a magical girl. But fate has something different in store for her.

title: End it Here
overview: Miyu attempts to capture the last card by herself using Saber's power.

title: Kaleidoscope
overview: Illya and Miyu must combine their strength in order to defeat Berserker whose Noble Phantasm allows him instant resurrections.
